scene.observations: A glider cart on a linear track oscillates back and forth on a spring, with LED indicators showing acceleration direction.

agent.message: The cart motion is well described by a damped harmonic oscillator along its main axis. The fitted natural frequency ω ≈ 2.74 rad/s gives about 0.47 Hz oscillation, consistent with the observed zero crossings. Damping ratio ζ ≈ 0.022 is small, so the oscillations decay slowly, matching the amplitude drop from first to last peak. The small offset s0 is a static equilibrium shift in the uncalibrated units.
agent.reasoning_summary: Verdict is accepted for damped harmonic oscillator with low held-out NRMSE. Scale is none so explanation uses frequency and damping ratio rather than absolute lengths. Parameters indicate lightly damped oscillatory motion along a nearly straight line.
